dialogues.speaker: Takami
dialogues.text: Hi, do you have any questions regarding festivals or the Fireworks Show?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me a bit about yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Takami
dialogues.text: I work for the Yashiro Commission and am in charge of the festivals and Fireworks Show. You can entrust me with any work that is related to event organizing, venue management, or festival- and Fireworks Show-related.

dialogues.speaker: Takami
dialogues.text: A traveler like yourself really must come and experience Inazuma's seasonal festivals and renowned Naganohara Fireworks Show.

dialogues.speaker: Takami
dialogues.text: Though short-lived, their radiant flares and meteoric glitters are a sight to remember for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About fireworks...

dialogues.speaker: Takami
dialogues.text: Speaking of our fireworks. Have you heard of Naganohara Fireworks? They are the oldest and one of the best fireworks shops in all of Inazuma. They're also the organizer of the Naganohara Fireworks Show.

dialogues.speaker: Takami
dialogues.text: I went to see the Naganohara Fireworks Show with my parents when I was still a child. I will never forget the spectacular sights that night.

dialogues.speaker: Takami
dialogues.text: It was that very moment that I realized my calling. I wanted to work somewhere related to the Fireworks Show to help and promote Inazuma's fireworks to all of Teyvat. This way, everyone will be able to witness and enjoy their beauty.

dialogues.speaker: Takami
dialogues.text: Thanks to Ms. Yoimiya, my wishes are slowly becoming realized, even with the restrictions of the Sakoku Decree.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about Yoimiya...

dialogues.speaker: Takami
dialogues.text: Ms. Yoimiya is the current shop keeper at Naganohara Fireworks. Not only has she inherited the firework craftsmanship of Mr. Naganohara, she is also amazing at running the shop.

dialogues.speaker: Takami
dialogues.text: She also takes in people's wishes and makes brand-new custom fireworks for them. When it comes to pyrotechnics that can light up the entire night sky, Yoimiya's the only one you can call.

dialogues.speaker: Takami
dialogues.text: She even had The Crux Fleet from Liyue ship fireworks overseas just to fulfill my ridiculous wish of spreading Naganohara Fireworks across all of Teyvat.

dialogues.speaker: Takami
dialogues.text: I'm not sure how she made it happen, but I am genuinely grateful and have the utmost respect for her.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Takami
dialogues.text: Alright, goodbye!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can I ask about those fireworks?

dialogues.speaker: Takami
dialogues.text: Speaking of our fireworks. Have you heard of Naganohara Fireworks? They are the oldest and one of the best fireworks shops in all of Inazuma. They're also the organizer of the Naganohara Fireworks Show.

dialogues.speaker: Takami
dialogues.text: I went to see the Naganohara Fireworks Show with my parents when I was still a child. I will never forget the spectacular sights that night.

dialogues.speaker: Takami
dialogues.text: It was that very moment that I realized my calling. I wanted to work somewhere related to the Fireworks Show to help and promote Inazuma's fireworks to all of Teyvat. This way, everyone will be able to witness and enjoy their beauty.

dialogues.speaker: Takami
dialogues.text: Now that the shipping lanes have been re-opened, and with Ms. Yoimiya's help, my wishes are now being realized.
